name: APIVerveChuckNorrisJokes
summary: Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters.
description:
Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters. Each call returns plain joke text ready to display in bots, command-line interfaces, or entertainment feeds.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Chuck Norris Jokes from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
